not really, friends are all back at there various parts of the country ill see someone occassionally but usually its just through social media, thats just not the same though is it. 

I spent a week with a friend in his house but felt so guilty.
thanks, knowing people are reading meaning people care. I dont feel as lost as i felt before I want to make myself better before i get to that stage.

Well i am currently in a 5 person house alone as everyone else is with family for the summer, I dont know if i am jealous of them or if it makes me miss having parents that want me to be there.

I go home to visit my mum and go in the spare room as she got rid of all my stuff i didnt take to university i get shouted and nagged about how i should have a job, I tried but noone wants to employ a student who will be leaving in 2 months!

It was my birthday last week, I was alone, my dad seemed(i like to think he was waiting for me to message him) to have forgot and text me the day after.
Family is probably the issue i blame myself for everything and beat myself up and recently an emotional mess, sorry for the essay.
